name: bcdevis-portable
author: Clinique Bellecour
description: BCDevis, application de devis locale pour Windows, macOS et ChromeOS.

scripts.test: node devis-portable/tests/core.test.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/pdf-main.test.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/keyboard-accessibility.test.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/theme-contracts.test.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/persistence-smoke.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/brand-pwa.test.cjs && node devis-portable/tests/platform-delivery.test.cjs
scripts.check: node --check devis-portable/app.js && node --check devis-portable/main.cjs && node --check devis-portable/preload.cjs && node --check devis-portable/service-worker.js && node --check scripts/build-chromeos.cjs && node --check scripts/require-build-platform.cjs && node --check scripts/pwa-server.cjs && node --check scripts/run-electron-script.cjs && node --check scripts/pdf-test-preload.cjs && node --check scripts/generate-signature-pdfs.cjs && npm test
scripts.exe: npm run check && npm run build:portable
scripts.mac: npm run check && node scripts/require-build-platform.cjs darwin && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal
scripts.linux: npm run check && node scripts/require-build-platform.cjs linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
